title: Embeddings-to-Rerank Starter Playbook: Microcopy, Pipeline Snapshots, and Annotated Screens
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Deliver a compact visual playbook and set of annotated screens to teach new users how to wire embeddings into a rerank pipeline inside Redwood Console and Docs. Focus on progressive disclosure: one-page pipeline snapshot, expandable microcopy for each node (embed -> candidate retrieval -> rerank -> final output), and 4 hero screenshots sized for product release notes and doc hero. Include accessible color variants and tokenized sample outputs so engineers and PMs can copy examples directly.
assets: Notion doc: Embeddings Rerank Visuals - PRD links and copy snippets
acceptance_criteria: One-page pipeline snapshot image (SVG + PNG) with labeled nodes and short microcopy for each node
Four annotated Console screenshots (onboarding modal, pipeline editor with sample corpus, rerank compare view, output verify modal) exported at 1440x900 and 640x360
Sample outputs for three scenarios (FAQ match, support ticket search, product recommendation) included as copyable code blocks in the Notion PRD
Accessibility checks passed: 4.5:1 contrast for text overlays; alt text for all images; keyboard focus order documented
design_notes: Use Redwood brand accent palettes but reserve orange for 'warning' only; primary CTA buttons should use blue-600
Pipeline snapshot should show implicit caching between Embed -> Retrieval to highlight performance gain
Microcopy to be written at ~10-12 words per node; avoid jargon like 'KV cache' in first-pass onboarding screens
Provide a collapsed advanced section that explains quantization and batching for advanced users

mock_output_examples:
Scenario: Support ticket search
User query: 'Why did my subscription charge change this month?'
Initial retrieval (top-5 IDs): [FAQ_02, BillingGuide_11, TOS_03, BillingFAQ_05, Churn_01]
Reranked top result: FAQ_02 - 'Why was my subscription charge different this month?' (score 0.92)
Final snippet shown: 'We recently updated prorated billing logic. See BillingGuide_11 for detailed examples.'

Scenario: Product recommendation
User query: 'I need a lightweight stroller for travel'
Retrieval candidates: [Prod_93, Blog_11, Prod_54, Review_08, Prod_113]
Reranked top result: Prod_54 - 'Ultralight Voyager Stroller' (score 0.88)
Final snippet shown: 'Ultralight Voyager — 11 lbs, folds with one hand, airline-friendly. Check specifications and shipping options.'

Scenario: Research FAQ
User query: 'What is KV cache and how does it affect latency?'
Retrieval candidates: [Infra_Doc_05, Blog_Infer_02, FAQ_09, Perf_Rundown_01, PR_124]
Reranked top result: Infra_Doc_05 - 'KV cache overview' (score 0.95)
Final snippet shown: 'KV cache stores recent key/value activations per session to avoid repeated compute on prefixes, lowering per-token latency for streaming chat.'
screenshots_requested: Onboarding modal: stepper showing 'Embed -> Retrieve -> Rerank -> Output' with microcopy visible
Pipeline editor: sample corpus loaded and candidate retrieval highlighted; show latency estimate badge and token cost estimate
Rerank compare: before/after rerank list with scores and explanation toggles
Output verify modal: user-editable snippet and 'copy sample prompt' button visible
